KS4 Revision Guides Letter: Writing Skills

Leaders are ambitious for all pupils in the school.” [Ofsted 2021] Our ethos “opening the door to success” and four core values embedded in our name DWHS (determination, wisdom, honesty, and service) together drive our intent and vision for curriculum provision and delivery.
The school’s curriculum enables our students to become: ■ confident, resilient individuals, who aspire to excellence and make outstanding progress leading to high quality qualifications.
In confirming our commitment to the broad and balanced principles of our curriculum we celebrate our expertise in mathematics and computing to drive excellence and innovation.

This is supported by a wide range of extra-curricular activities, such as public speaking, master classes, debating, mentoring, and visits to universities and workplaces.
Students are able to express themselves in the visual and performing arts in our well-resourced art and music rooms, and drama studios equipped with sound and light facilities.
